role: Retrospective characterization only; never changes automatic QT/QTc or hides lower-agreement proposals
selectionDisclosure: Thresholds selected after inspecting errors in both exposed development cohorts; descriptive strata, not preregistered validation gates.
limitations: Leads and beats within records are correlated.
High-agreement is not probability, clinical confidence or authorization for automatic QT.
All lower-agreement proposals remain visible and reported.
External untouched validation is required before considering automatic QT.
